meanings.meaning: A short saying that is often repeated and teaches a truth or wise lesson learned from life.
A hard-to-understand saying, like a riddle or parable. A listener has to think carefully to see what it means.
A byword: a name or example people repeat to mock someone. To become a proverb means to be an object of shame and scorn.
A saying or phrase that people often repeat and everyone knows. It may be a common line that people quote, even if it is not a wise lesson.
